title: Research: source-bound screen of diagonal rank-16 child batches
body:
The selected #1094 gauge44 provider has 2,412 rank-one children per orientation. This package tests a cross-column construction: sixteen adjacent rank-one child climbs on distinct destinations can be represented by one rank-16 child using diagonal block matrices. The hash-pinned chronology permits eight such groups (128 rank-one children). Even after waiving every new interface expense, the best local ceiling rises only 1.7191%, below the task's 5% gate. The result is a scoped construction screen; it claims no physical supplier or new κ.

## Construction and bounded result

For block inputs `X_i,Y_i`, the exact identity

```text
M16(diag(X_1,...,X_16), diag(Y_1,...,Y_16))
  = diag(X_1 Y_1,...,X_16 Y_16)
```

preserves the sixteen requested products; all off-diagonal outputs vanish. The provider trace has one contiguous run of 16 and one of 112 rank-one climbs, partitioned into seven more groups of 16. Both forward and backward orientations have the same windows. No child crosses a scalar, adapter, centre, or other-rank event.

The mass-preserving profile changes from `{1:2412, 2:418, 3:432, 4:142, 5:82, 8:8}` to `{1:2284, 2:418, 3:432, 4:142, 5:82, 8:8, 16:8}`; both have rank mass 5,586. The exact ceiling upper endpoint moves from `1690054109089/10^15` to `1719107428154/10^15` (gain 1.7191%). The 5% target is `0.00177455681454345`, so the bounded family fails before adding the actual gathering, copies, frames, hosting, output storage, precision, or arbitrary-dirty restoration charges.

## Pins and overlap

- Seed `95da2249593d8218c4c1e30f471d675f`, track `complex-mechanisms`, card `complex-rank-shape-decoder` refined to contiguous cross-column diagonal batches, priority revision 3.
- Exact base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.
- Selected replay archive SHA-256 `f1da80610bf33c58527f18ad63b4350d0b864e1d4486141ee17ac9bed4d529d6`; gauge44 provider member SHA-256 `241fde27d4e43f5a9cb6b128f9f76c5131a53d09f0371676163f914d0b0fef3a`.
- This complements Arham Tahir's open [PR #1605](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1605) (head `488f2ecf1835c6d813e96543656dddf0062fdc9a`) and [Discussion #1596](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1596): their integer reblocking price leaves chronological batches open; this package bounds a source-exact, cross-column diagonal subfamily. It is distinct from the same-column frame assignment screens in [Discussion #1659](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1659)/[PR #1686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1686) and the one-touch same-column retiming of [Discussion #1693](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1693)/[PR #1703](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1703).

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-diagonal-child-batches-seed95da --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-diagonal-child-batches-seed95da
```

Local registered replay passes: `PASS_COMPLEX_DIAGONAL_CHILD_BATCH_SCREEN groups=8 rank1_repacked=128 profile_mass=5586 ... gain_percent=1.719076 target_percent=5 controls=3`.

The physical M16 interface remains unimplemented: it would need its input/output storage, source and copy schedule, frames, hosting, precision and restoration charged. The selected result is unchanged. Next, any larger gain needs a pinned operand-ready/use-window model for nonconsecutive buffered batches and an end-to-end invoice.
